exactChecks: Gap occupancy probabilities for 16 pool sizes; random sorted old priorities agree with all uniform interleaving pattern probabilities.

comparison.method: Seeded Monte Carlo with shared independent draws by purpose; old-position draws use a shared prefix across counts; new IDs share priorities across runs.
comparison.scope: All subsequences of four old IDs in one shared order. Count cases are proper nested subsets; identity cases have equal lengths. One, two or four new IDs. Pair classes and new-pool sizes receive equal aggregate weight.
comparison.metric: Same event ID at the first output and at corresponding positions among the first min(3, both lengths) outputs; each pair receives equal weight.
